name: The Bloom
summary: The Rootched finished what the Sundering started. The Loom is a tree now, and the districts are its roots, and everyone who stayed is part of everyone else. It is warm. It hums. It is not, quite, human.

sera.alive: Sera burned her way out of the green and kept going. There are still places it has not reached.
sera.dead: The green grew over Sera's grave first. It remembered her.

kaj7.alive: Kaj-7 rooted beside the Beacon. It sings with the rest now, and it is finally not afraid.
kaj7.dead: Something with Kaj-7's voice sings under the plaza. It is not Kaj-7.

dax.alive: Dax's vault opened from the inside. His family walked out into the green and did not walk back.
dax.dead: The green found Dax's vault. The seal did not matter after all.
